claim: state suppression of polygyny (enforced monogamy) is the fertility-favouring institution in the developed regime
evidence: enforced-monogamy dividend mean ΔTFR +0.698 (>0): reversing the excluded-male externality lifts C and S (Henrich 2012); the spectrum optimum sits at the suppression corner e=-1.0

claim: cultural / society endorsement of polygyny raises fertility
evidence: developed-regime sweep slopes down through endorsement; at cultural endorsement e=+0.5 mean ΔTFR -0.803 - a loss

claim: state endorsement + subsidy of polygyny manufactures the missing quantum
evidence: full state endorsement e=+1 mean ΔTFR -0.807; the subsidy offsets part of the S loss but not the C drag - subsidy x parity is antagonistic

claim: the development regime flips the sign of polygyny (Tertilt +40% only in low-development)
evidence: at full endorsement e=+1 the developed regime gives -0.807 but the low-development regime gives +0.263 - opposite signs, the Tertilt sign-flip; developed optimum is suppression (e=-1.0), low-dev optimum is endorsement (e=+1.0)

claim: polyandry endorsement suppresses fertility regardless of endorsement level
evidence: polyandry sweep is negative across e, at full endorsement mean ΔTFR -0.595; surplus unmarried women (Goldstein 1976) - a brake at every endorsement level

claim: state suppression of polyandry raises fertility by un-rationing women's reproduction
evidence: suppressing polyandry mean ΔTFR +0.117; mechanically un-rations female reproduction but the effect is small in a low-childlessness-headroom developed regime

claim: the excluded-sex externality on C scales with endorsement reach
evidence: the fC drag grows monotonically with |e| in the builder; the developed sweep's downslope is driven by it - reach amplifies the externality

claim: endorsement shifts the bistable norm N enough to matter on its own
evidence: norm-endorse standalone mean ΔTFR -0.111; the fN arm alone is weak - legitimacy without a material channel is cheap talk (E25 H187 hysteresis)

claim: a state subsidy offsets the polygyny externality
evidence: subsidy x polygyny-reach interaction -0.492; the subsidy lifts S but cannot repair the C collapse - antagonistic to the parity loss, does not flip the sign

claim: the excluded-male crime side-effect dominates any polygyny fertility gain
evidence: crime index rises 3.4x with reach (Edlund 2013) while developed ΔTFR falls - the side-effect and the fertility effect both push against endorsement; net stacked, polygyny endorsement is dominated

claim: polygyny is a viable lever once women's autonomy is priced in
evidence: polygyny lowers female autonomy (the Doepke-Kindermann / Kleven gender-equity root lever) on top of the fertility loss - dominated on both the fertility and the autonomy axis

claim: the interaction structure is dominated by the development sign-flip and the reach x externality
evidence: largest off-diagonal cell is polygyny-reach x low-dev (-0.309); enforce-mono antagonises polygyny-reach; the matrix has no super-additive pro-fertility endorsement cell in the developed regime

claim: the spectrum optimum is an interior endorsement level
evidence: the developed-regime optimum is the CORNER at suppression (e=-1.0), not interior - endorsement monotonically worsens fertility; the interior-optimum claim is refuted

claim: across the whole spectrum no polygamy variant lifts developed-regime TFR net of side-effects
evidence: every developed endorsement point is <=0 and carries a rising crime + autonomy cost; only the suppression corner (enforced monogamy) is fertility-and-stability-favouring - the closing synthesis
